【文章标题】：Versa Concerto 0-Day Flaw Enables Remote Code Execution by Bypassing Authentication
【文章摘要】：Versa Concerto, a network security and SD-WAN platform, has a critical 0-day vulnerability allowing remote code execution via authentication bypass and arbitrary file write. Attackers can exploit this to gain unauthorized access, upload malicious files, and escalate privileges to the host system.

【文章标题】：CISA警报：Vertiv产品容易受到RCE、身份验证旁路（CVSS9.8）的攻击
【文章摘要】：CISA发布警报，指出Vertiv的Liebert RDU101和IS-UNITY产品存在高严重性漏洞，包括远程代码执行和身份验证旁路，CVSS评分为9.8。攻击者可利用这些漏洞获取设备控制权，影响数据中心和基础设施的安全。
